identity.intro: Create your account. Your default workspace is ready after you verify your email.
identity.passwordHint: Use 10–128 characters, including at least one uppercase letter and one special character.
identity.correctFields: Please correct the required fields above.
identity.unavailable: The service could not complete the request. Check your connection and try again.
identity.pending: Our email provider has accepted the verification email. Check your inbox and spam folder. Delivery may take a few minutes. Use the latest link; it expires after 24 hours.
identity.verifiedHint: Your email is verified. Opening your workspace…
identity.verifyHint: Your verification link signs you in and opens your workspace automatically.
identity.invalidLink: This link is missing or invalid. Open the full link from your latest email, or request a new one below.
identity.cooldown: You can request another email in {{seconds}} seconds.
identity.loginRequired: Log in with a verified account to access your workspace.
identity.failedDelivery: The last email attempt failed. We will retry automatically. An earlier link, if any, is unchanged.
identity.queued: Your registration is saved and your verification email is queued. We will send it shortly. Verify your email to activate your account and create your default workspace.
identity.deliveryCancelled: This email request is no longer available. Log in if you have already verified your account.
identity.emailLocked: This is the email saved with your registration. It cannot be changed here.

home.label: Workspace home
home.intro: Your workspace has a home. Here’s to making every lesson count and every next step a little smarter.
home.nextTitle: Great things start with your team.
home.nextDescription: Invite colleagues to your workspace and give your team a shared place to grow.
home.footer: Keep the context. Build on the experience. Move forward together.
home.memberDescription: You have joined your team’s shared space. More ways to learn and grow together are coming soon.

invitations.title: Bring your team together.
invitations.denied: Log in as a verified workspace administrator to invite team members.
invitations.eyebrow: A shared space starts with your people
invitations.intro: Invite colleagues to your workspace, one email at a time. Work or personal addresses are welcome.
invitations.formHint: All you need is their email address.
invitations.invalid: Enter a valid email address, up to 254 characters.
invitations.failed: The invitation could not be sent. Please try again.
invitations.uncertain: We could not confirm the result. Check the send status before trying again. If it remains in progress, contact support.
invitations.footer: Invitations expire after seven days. Your colleague can join with an existing account or create one. Pending invitations do not reserve an active-account slot.
invitations.pendingHint: Resending and managing pending invitations will be available in a future update. Your existing invitation remains unchanged.
invitations.loadFailed: We could not load your account. Please try again.
invitations.historyHint: Saved invitations for your workspace, newest first.
invitations.historyError: Previous invitations could not be loaded. Please try again.

acceptance.title: Make yourself at home.
acceptance.intro: Join this workspace alongside your default workspace. Members can read all workspace knowledge and edit only tickets they created.
acceptance.invalid: This invitation is invalid. Please contact the workspace administrator for a valid invitation.
acceptance.loadFailed: We could not check your invitation. Please try again.
acceptance.uncertain: We could not confirm registration. Check the invitation status before trying again. If it was accepted, log in with the password you just chose.
acceptance.welcome: Your account is active and you are signed in to {{workspace}}.
acceptance.bound: This email and workspace come from your invitation and cannot be changed.
acceptance.nameError: Enter your full name, up to 200 characters.

team.title: Manage your team
team.intro: See who has joined your workspace and follow up on invitations.
team.scrollHint: Scroll horizontally to see all details.
team.loadFailed: Records could not be loaded. Please retry.
team.uncertain: The resend outcome could not be confirmed. Refresh the list before retrying; the previous link remains valid until a replacement is confirmed.
team.noInvitationsHint: Invite a colleague to start building your team.
team.noMembersHint: Colleagues will appear here after completing registration.

knowledge.title: Your knowledge workspace.
knowledge.intro: Keep the context. Share the treasure.
knowledge.titleHint: Give your knowledge a clear, recognizable name.
knowledge.captureHint: What are you capturing, and why is it worth keeping?

guidance.Knowledge: Explain the insight, its context, and when it is useful.
guidance.Coding: Include a nonempty code block and explain how to use it.
guidance.Problem: Describe what happened, what you investigated, and what you learned.
guidance.Decision: Explain the decision, alternatives, and reasoning.
guidance.Accomplishment: Describe what you achieved and its impact.
guidance.Learning: Explain what you learned and how to apply it.

knowledge.aiHint: Rephrase existing Title or Capture wording independently. Keep the same meaning and a similar length. Enter text in a field before refining it.
knowledge.autoAttributes: Attributes are added automatically after publishing.
knowledge.polishIntro: Polish only what you wrote in Title or Capture. Suggestions stay concise and preserve your meaning.
knowledge.attributeHint: Added after publishing. Keep writing naturally.
knowledge.externalAi: Refinement sends only the selected field to OpenAI. Automatic classification sends the full ticket content after publication. Do not include sensitive information.
knowledge.leave: Leave without publishing? Your unsaved writing will be lost.
knowledge.success: Ticket published. Your workspace can read it now.
knowledge.unavailable: The request could not finish. Your writing is preserved. Please retry.
knowledge.retryHint: Your content is preserved. If publication is uncertain, editing is paused; retry to safely retrieve the same published ticket.
knowledge.TICKET_NOT_FOUND: This ticket is unavailable in your workspace.
knowledge.browseIntro: Useful context, shared by your workspace.
knowledge.filteredEmpty: No tickets of this type yet
knowledge.browseError: Knowledge could not be loaded. Please retry.
knowledge.detailRefreshError: This ticket could not be refreshed. The loaded content is still available. Please retry.
knowledge.workspaceChanged: Workspace access changed. This draft stays in its original workspace and cannot be published here. Copy any writing you need before leaving.

workspace.label: Workspace
workspace.intro: A shared home for what your team learns. Make every lesson count.
workspace.knowledgeDescription: Find the context, solutions, and lessons your workspace captures.

individual.title: A place for what you learn.
individual.intro: Start with your own workspace. Invite others whenever you want to collaborate.
individual.boundary: One account. Multiple workspaces. Your knowledge stays within its workspace.
individual.formIntro: Create your account. Your default workspace will be ready after email verification.
individual.orEmail: Or continue with email and password
individual.providerUnavailable: Some social sign-in options are currently unavailable. You can continue with email and password.
individual.visibility: Only you can view these tickets. Your knowledge stays in your personal workspace.
individual.linkIntro: Confirm that you want to use {{provider}} to sign in to the account you just authenticated.
individual.linkSuccess: You can now sign in using either linked method. Both open the same account.
individual.reauthenticate: Sign in again with an existing method
individual.linkExpired: There is no active linking request. Start again with the provider you want to connect.

errors.LINK_REQUIRED: This email already has an account. Sign in using your existing password or linked provider, then confirm the new provider link.
errors.PROVIDER_EMAIL_UNVERIFIED: Your provider reports an unverified email. Verify it with the provider and try again.
errors.PROVIDER_EMAIL_MISSING: The provider did not share a usable email. Allow email access or use email and password.
errors.ACCOUNT_INACTIVE: Verify your email before signing in. You can request another verification email below.
errors.PROVIDER_AUTHENTICATION_FAILED: Provider sign-in was cancelled or could not be validated. Try again or use another sign-in method.
errors.PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE: Provider sign-in is temporarily unavailable. Please try again.
errors.SIGNUP_REQUIRED: Create an account using email and password first.

individual.linkUnavailable: Linking is temporarily unavailable. Please retry.
